qe: If the second half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 10th to the left of 14th from the left end?
qh: यदि द्वितीय अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो बाएँ छोर से 14वें अक्षर के बाएँ 10वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (First Half Unchanged Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Series structure samjhein:
- First half (A se M): Normal sequence $A, B, C, \dots, L, M$ (1 se 13 tak).
- Second half (N se Z) reversed: $Z, Y, X, \dots, O, N$ (14 se 26 tak).
Step 2: Samaan dishaon (Left aur Left) ke liye positions ko ghataayein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = 14 - 10 = 4\text{th letter}$$
Step 3: Chuki $4 \le 13$, yeh letter unchanged first half me aata hai.
- 'A' se shuru hone wali normal series me 4th letter 'D' hota hai.
Correct 'F' hai.

Method 2 (Direct Alphabet Inspection):
First half bilkul normal order me hai, isliye baayein se chautha letter seedhe 'D' hoga.
Sahi uttar 'D' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the second half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 6th to the left of 15th from the left end?
qh: यदि द्वितीय अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो बाएँ छोर से 15वें अक्षर के बाएँ छठा अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Within First-Half Boundary Shortcut):
Step 1: Left se net position calculate karein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = 15 - 6 = 9\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: $9 \le 13$ hone ke karan yeh letter normal first half ($A \dots M$) me hi sthit hai.
Step 3: Normal alphabet me baayein se 9वाँ letter 'I' hota hai.
Correct option  I hai.

Method 2 (Visual Offset Method):
15th letter second half me tha, lekin 6 sthan piche aane par sthiti 9th ban jaati hai jo first half ka hissa hai. 'A' se 9th letter 'I' prapt hota hai.
Sahi uttar 'I' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the second half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 5th to the right of 10th from the left end?
qh: यदि द्वितीय अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो बाएँ छोर से 10वें अक्षर के दाएँ 5वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Reversed Second-Half Offset Trick):
Step 1: Baayein chhor se kul sthiti nikalein (Left + Right):
$$\text{Position from Left} = 10 + 5 = 15\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Pehle 13 letters first half ke paar karne par second half ($Z \dots N$) me sthiti:
$$15 - 13 = 2\text{nd letter from 'Z'}$$
Step 3: 'Z' se countdown karein ($Z$ = 1st, $Y$ = 2nd) ya formula $(26 + 1 - 2 = 25)$ lagayein:
$$\text{Original Position} = 25$$
25वाँ letter 'Y' hota hai.
Correct option  Y hai.

Method 2 (Direct Inspection in Second Half):
Second half baayein se shuru hota hai: $Z(14\text{th}), Y(15\text{th})$.
15th position par letter 'Y' aata hai.
Sahi uttar 'Y' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the second half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 7th to the right of 13th from the left end?
qh: यदि द्वितीय अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो बाएँ छोर से 13वें अक्षर के दाएँ 7वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Second-Half Inversion Shortcut):
Step 1: Left end se effective position nikalein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = 13 + 7 = 20\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: First half (13 letters) hatane par second half me sthiti:
$$20 - 13 = 7\text{th letter from 'Z'}$$
Step 3: 'Z' ki taraf se 7th letter ki original place value:
$$\text{Original Position} = (26 + 1) - 7 = 20$$
Alphabet me 20वाँ letter 'T' hota hai.
Correct option  T hai.

Method 2 (Direct Countdown from Z):
Second half sequence: $Z(1), Y(2), X(3), W(4), V(5), U(6), T(7)$.
7th letter 'T' prapt hota hai.
Sahi uttar 'T' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the second half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 5th to the right of 10th from the right end?
qh: यदि द्वितीय अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 10वें अक्षर के दाएँ 5वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Right-to-Left in Second Half Shortcut):
Step 1: Same directions (Right aur Right) hone par ghataayein:
$$\text{Position from Right} = 10 - 5 = 5\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Chuki $5 \le 13$, yeh letter reversed second half ($Z \dots N$) me daayein chhor par sthit hai.
Step 3: Daayein (Right) end par letter 'N' (original 14th letter) hai, isliye 'N' se 5 kadam aage badhein:
$$\text{Original Position} = 13 + 5 = 18$$
18वाँ letter 'R' hota hai.
Correct option  R hai.

Method 2 (Sequential Counting from N):
Daayein छोर se sequence: $N(1), O(2), P(3), Q(4), R(5)$.
5th letter 'R' hai.
Sahi uttar 'R' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the second half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 5th to the right of 15th from the right end?
qh: यदि द्वितीय अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 15वें अक्षर के दाएँ 5वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Second Half Offset from N Shortcut):
Step 1: Right end se net position nikalein:
$$\text{Position from Right} = 15 - 5 = 10\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: $10 \le 13$ hone ke karan yeh letter second half me hi hai.
Step 3: Daayein chhor par 'N' (14th) hone se 'N' se 10वाँ letter:
$$\text{Original Position} = 13 + 10 = 23$$
23वाँ letter 'W' hota hai.
Correct option  W hai.

Method 2 (Counting from N Method):
$N(1), O(2), P(3), Q(4), R(5), S(6), T(7), U(8), V(9), W(10)$.
Daayein se 10th letter 'W' prapt hota hai.
Sahi uttar 'W' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the second half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 5th to the left of 11th from the right end?
qh: यदि द्वितीय अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 11वें अक्षर के बाएँ 5वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Right-End Crossing into First Half Shortcut):
Step 1: Right end se total position nikalein (Right + Left):
$$\text{Position from Right} = 11 + 5 = 16\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Total 26 letters me right se 16th letter ki left se sthiti nikalein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = (26 + 1) - 16 = 11\text{th letter}$$
Step 3: Chuki $11 \le 13$, yeh letter normal first half ($A \dots M$) me sthit hai.
- Normal alphabet me 11वाँ letter 'K' hota hai.
Correct option  K hai.

Method 2 (Boundary Subtraction Method):
Second half ke 13 letters cross karne ke baad: $16 - 13 = 3$rd letter into first half from 'M'.
'M' se piche ki or: $M(1), L(2), K(3)$.
Sahi uttar 'K' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.
